provenance.note: Tests repo_scope filtering in L4 skill matching and strict injection scoping (NULL scope is never injected unless is_global).

task_description: L4 procedural memory scoping: a skill planted with repo_scope must be chosen over an off-topic skill for its own repository and must not be chosen for another repository. A NULL-scope skill (no repo_scope, is_global unset) must stay listable via GET /skills but must never be injected into a runtime context.
test_steps: Plant an on-topic skill and an off-topic skill, both scoped to repo A, plus a NULL-scope deploy skill (no repo_scope, is_global unset)
POST /skills/match with a deploy query and repo_path=repo A
Verify the on-topic scoped skill ranks above the off-topic plant
POST /skills/match with the same query and repo_path=repo B
Verify the repo-A skill is not returned at all
Verify the NULL-scope skill is listed by GET /skills but absent from select_skills_for_context for repo A, repo B, and an unscoped request
